comparison.objective: Extract and recover a spacer with a pusher; candidate replaces a motion-control harness connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Indirect tool pushing and part recovery versus connector unlatching, extraction, alignment, mating, and cable/seal management.
comparison.success_condition: PR has measured exit, nest, tool-return, release, and containment gates; candidate lacks equipment geometry, procedure, and any defensible completion or damage rubric.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is constrained indirect extraction with a separate tool, not electrical connector replacement.
